display_name: 基于输入置信度的恢复候选选择源域筛选
description: 固定四种恢复候选，用冻结基座对输入候选的置信度进行选择，逐场景对比盲父模型与 DURA。

data.version: original7/63/30 Phase1 source physical ID contract
data.representation: IQ [2,256], frozen parent and 3 noise-adaptive candidate IQ signals; input-only F confidence selector and protection gate
data.tx_sets_ref: No TX labels, U_s truth, V or test read; F clean pseudo targets for source evaluation

permissions.query_use: Source-only pilot with RX8 source holdout; no target IQ, V, or truth
permissions.claim_scope: Single seed source-only diagnostic; no independent blind or real satellite claim

checkpoint.initialization: Fixed clean denoiser SHA256 5f23bc370ea445dbffe21e1a125f1066321a9df46a1c90e0b617648255323642 and blind model SHA256 0ef60a205f785bda45f9936d519e925179dbbddeef2fd6cd285a83b02a284338; fixed source Gaussian prior, F and input gate.
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Exact denoiser, blind model and source prior SHA256 checked at runtime; source screening rules pinned 86acfb414d70c638ef086e318739cc158a9b6601.
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Frozen designated Phase1 source contract; previous Phase1 development results observed, no clean-blind claim
checkpoint.selection_rule: RX4/6 each receiver/scene pseudo-correct drop <= max(1,ceil(.5% valid)); clean IQ <=reference+.001; impaired IQ <=1.2*reference+1e-6; aggregate impaired gain >=10. Input gate .8/.99, confidence margin 0/.05/.15; DURA and blind parent. RX8 excluded.

metrics_plan.scientific_rule: Pseudo targets not truth; source seen in other views; selected candidate requires separate fixed Phase1 predictions and truth-last scoring.

rows.method: frozen F input-candidate confidence selector over parent and three noise adaptive IQ outputs
rows.purpose: source selection versus DURA and parent after small candidate complementarity study
rows.seed_notes: prior sample same as fixed estimator; source split 2026110551; no additional model updates
rows.scenario: source clean and six simulated impaired scenes

notes: Broad screening fixed after observing the 384-record candidate pilot; source IDs seen in other simulated views, not independent blind.
Three fixed input-only confidence margins and two gate thresholds; primary IQ guard plus accuracy-only audit.
No TX labels, U_s truth, V, target IQ or automatic Phase1 test.
